fields.name: benchmark_case_id
fields.description: Stable benchmark case identifier encoding every swept parameter.

fields.name: benchmark_group
fields.description: pytest-benchmark's group label, which publish_case_metadata sets to the case scenario: read for dataloading, checkpoint_write for checkpointing. Same value as workload_scenario; filter on workload_family and workload_implementation to tell the loaders within a subsystem apart.

fields.name: workload_implementation
fields.description: Library or integration executing the workload, matching the run.py --group suffix: huggingface_datasets, webdataset, pytorch_lightning, or ray_data.

fields.name: workload_scenario
fields.description: Operation exercised within the workload implementation, named by the scenario in the group's configs.yaml: read for dataloading, checkpoint_write for checkpointing.

fields.name: config_sweep_axis
fields.description: Configuration axis that produced this case, or baseline for the implicit baseline case.

fields.name: workload_family
fields.description: Broad benchmark row family: data_loading or checkpointing. With workload_implementation it identifies the runnable group, which benchmark_group also carries verbatim (note data_loading here against the dataloading directory the group name uses).

fields.name: distributed_backend
fields.description: Auto-detected distributed execution backend, such as gloo or nccl; an environment fact rather than a benchmark parameter.

fields.name: compute_accelerator_type
fields.description: Auto-detected compute accelerator type, currently cpu or gpu; an environment fact rather than a benchmark parameter.

fields.name: machine_type
fields.description: GCE machine type of the benchmark VM; empty outside GCE.

fields.name: world_size
fields.description: Number of distributed ranks participating in the case; 1 for a single-rank case.

fields.name: gcs_bucket_name
fields.description: Isolated GCS bucket created for this benchmark case and used for Cloud Monitoring correlation.

fields.name: bucket_type
fields.description: Storage tier of the case bucket: regional, zonal (RAPID), or hns.

fields.name: benchmark_source_commit_sha
fields.description: Cloud Build source revision containing the benchmark harness, configuration, and pipeline.

fields.name: requirements_override
fields.description: Normalized whitespace-separated Python requirement specs installed after the group pins; empty when the copied checkout is used unchanged.

fields.name: requirements_resolved
fields.description: JSON list from pip describing final installed distribution names and resolved versions.

fields.name: config_sweep_axes_requested
fields.description: Normalized requested config sweep axes, or all when the complete group was selected; baseline is included automatically.

fields.name: measurement_round_count
fields.description: Number of measured rounds represented by the round-duration statistics. A round is one timed unit of the workload: one full-corpus iteration for dataloading, one checkpoint operation for checkpointing.

fields.name: dataloader_num_workers
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. DataLoader worker process count per distributed rank (or Ray Data reader task concurrency); 0 means in-process loading or library-default concurrency. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema.

fields.name: batch_size_samples
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Number of samples yielded per data batch.

fields.name: sample_sequence_length_tokens
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/huggingface_datasets and dataloading/ray_data. Number of tokens in each generated dataset sample.

fields.name: dataset_format
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. On-GCS representation of the generated dataset, pairing stored payload with container: pretok_parquet, text_parquet, pretok_jsonl, image_tar_jpeg, image_tar_png, image_tar_npy, or image_tar_gz_jpeg. Image payload encoding rides here rather than in a column of its own, matching how pretok_ and text_ already distinguish payloads sharing a container.

fields.name: parquet_row_group_size_rows
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/huggingface_datasets and dataloading/ray_data. Number of rows per Parquet row group; not applicable to non-Parquet formats.

fields.name: dataset_file_count
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Number of files in the generated dataset.

fields.name: dataset_size_bytes
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Total stored size in bytes of the generated GCS dataset objects. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema.

fields.name: dataset_sample_count
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Total number of samples in the generated dataset; every measured round must yield this count.

fields.name: dataloader_prefetch_factor
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Batches prefetched per DataLoader worker; meaningful only when the worker count is greater than zero. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema.

fields.name: read_access_pattern
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Dataset traversal pattern: sequential, shuffled, or shuffled_samples_only (sample buffer shuffled, shard list read in listing order). A shard shuffle is only meaningful under a shuffled pattern, so it refines this value rather than taking a column of its own.

fields.name: dataset_split_by_node_enabled
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Whether the dataset is partitioned across distributed ranks with split-by-node semantics.

fields.name: persistent_data_loader_workers_enabled
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Whether DataLoader worker processes persist between measured rounds.

fields.name: shuffle_max_buffer_input_shards
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/huggingface_datasets. Maximum input shards retained separately by streaming shuffle; 0 selects the library default.

fields.name: image_max_pixels
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. Maximum stored pixels per image; dimensions are patch-aligned within this budget.

fields.name: image_jpeg_quality
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. JPEG quality used at prep time; 0 for non-JPEG encodings, which dataset_format identifies.

fields.name: sample_layout
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. What one sample holds: image_text_pair (one image per document) or interleaved_document (several).

fields.name: dataset_image_count
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. Total number of images in the generated dataset; equals dataset_sample_count for image_text_pair corpora. Images per second, the rate comparable across encodings and sample layouts, is mean_samples_per_second * dataset_image_count / dataset_sample_count -- every measured round reads the whole corpus, so no separate column carries it.

fields.name: gcs_read_mode
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. How gcsfs delivered shard bytes: default (adaptive prefetcher), readahead_32mb (explicit cache_type, prefetcher off), or whole_object.

fields.name: gcs_read_concurrency
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. Requested parallel ranged GETs per shard read. Only takes effect on reads of at least 2x gcsfs's 5 MiB minimum concurrent chunk, so it is swept together with gcs_read_buffer_bytes; at gcs_read_buffer_bytes 0 it has no effect under any read mode.

fields.name: gcs_read_buffer_bytes
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. Client-side read buffer placed in front of the gcsfs handle, or 0 for none. Sets the size of the reads that actually reach gcsfs: webdataset reads tars in 10 KiB units, so this is what determines request count and whether gcs_read_concurrency can apply.

fields.name: shuffle_buffer_size
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Samples held in the streaming shuffle buffer; 0 means sample shuffling is off. Whether the shard list was also shuffled is carried by read_access_pattern. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema, which is why it carries no unit suffix.

fields.name: shard_resampling_enabled
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. Whether shards were sampled with replacement instead of partitioned into exact epochs.

fields.name: image_decode_enabled
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. Whether images were decoded to tensors inside the timed loop.

fields.name: local_shard_cache_enabled
fields.description: Populated by dataloading/webdataset. Whether shards were cached on local disk across rounds.

fields.name: dataset_read_throughput_mean_bytes_per_second
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Mean logical dataset-read throughput in bytes per second across measured rounds.

fields.name: mean_samples_per_second
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Mean dataset-read throughput in samples per second across measured rounds. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema.

fields.name: time_to_first_batch_seconds
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Seconds from the start of the first measured round until its first batch; null when a rank received no data at all.

fields.name: dataset_build_time
fields.description: Populated by dataloading. Duration in seconds spent constructing and preparing the dataset before measured rounds. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema, which is why it carries no unit suffix.

fields.name: measurement_window_start_unix_seconds
fields.description: Unix timestamp in seconds at the beginning of the measured read window.

fields.name: measurement_window_end_unix_seconds
fields.description: Unix timestamp in seconds at the end of the measured read window.

fields.name: dataset_read_bytes
fields.description: Populated by dataloading, from Cloud Monitoring after the run. Bytes reported by the GCS network sent-bytes metric for the isolated case bucket during the measurement window. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema.

fields.name: dataset_read_request_count
fields.description: Populated by dataloading, from Cloud Monitoring after the run. Count of GCS ReadObject and BidiReadObject requests for the isolated case bucket during the measurement window. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema.

fields.name: dataset_read_amplification_ratio
fields.description: Populated by dataloading, from Cloud Monitoring after the run. GCS network bytes sent divided by dataset size times measured round count; 1 means each stored byte was served once per round. Shared name with the macrobenchmarks schema.

fields.name: cpu_usage_peak_cores
fields.description: Peak CPU usage in cores summed across the benchmark process tree during the measurement window.

fields.name: memory_usage_peak_bytes
fields.description: Peak resident memory in bytes summed across the benchmark process tree during the measurement window.

fields.name: network_received_bytes
fields.description: Total host network bytes received during the measurement window.

fields.name: network_sent_bytes
fields.description: Total host network bytes sent during the measurement window.

fields.name: network_received_mean_bytes_per_sec
fields.description: Mean host network receive rate in bytes per second during the measurement window.

fields.name: network_sent_mean_bytes_per_sec
fields.description: Mean host network send rate in bytes per second during the measurement window.

fields.name: host_vcpu_count
fields.description: vCPU count of the benchmark host.

fields.name: round_duration_min_seconds
fields.description: Minimum measured round duration in seconds; a round is one full-corpus iteration for dataloading and one checkpoint operation for checkpointing.

fields.name: round_duration_max_seconds
fields.description: Maximum measured round duration in seconds.

fields.name: round_duration_mean_seconds
fields.description: Arithmetic mean of measured round durations in seconds.

fields.name: round_duration_p50_seconds
fields.description: 50th-percentile measured round duration in seconds.

fields.name: round_duration_stddev_seconds
fields.description: Standard deviation of measured round durations in seconds.

fields.name: round_duration_p90_seconds
fields.description: 90th-percentile measured round duration in seconds.

fields.name: round_duration_p95_seconds
fields.description: 95th-percentile measured round duration in seconds.

fields.name: round_duration_p99_seconds
fields.description: 99th-percentile measured round duration in seconds.

fields.name: checkpoint_read_bytes
fields.description: Bytes reported by the GCS network sent-bytes metric for the isolated case bucket during the measurement window.

fields.name: checkpoint_read_amplification_ratio
fields.description: GCS network bytes sent divided by physical checkpoint size times measurement round count.

fields.name: checkpoint_read_request_count
fields.description: Count of GCS ReadObject and BidiReadObject requests for the isolated case bucket during the measurement window.

fields.name: checkpoint_physical_size_bytes
fields.description: Total physical size in bytes of the checkpoint files.

fields.name: checkpoint_strategy
fields.description: Checkpointing strategy used (single, ddp, fsdp, etc.).

fields.name: checkpoint_write_throughput_mean_bytes_per_second
fields.description: Mean write throughput in bytes per second for the checkpoint save operation.

fields.name: checkpoint_read_throughput_mean_bytes_per_second
fields.description: Mean read throughput in bytes per second for the checkpoint load operation.

fields.name: model_id
fields.description: Hugging Face model ID or path used for the benchmark.

fields.name: tensor_parallel_size
fields.description: ModelParallelStrategy tensor-parallel degree (TP). N/A for non-model_parallel runs.

fields.name: data_parallel_size
fields.description: ModelParallelStrategy data-parallel degree (DP). N/A for non-model_parallel runs.

fields.name: setup_world_size
fields.description: Number of distributed ranks used to save the checkpoint initially. Defaults to world_size.

fields.name: setup_tensor_parallel_size
fields.description: ModelParallelStrategy tensor-parallel degree used to save the checkpoint initially. Defaults to tensor_parallel_size.

fields.name: setup_data_parallel_size
fields.description: ModelParallelStrategy data-parallel degree used to save the checkpoint initially. Defaults to data_parallel_size.
